## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` all pass
- [ ] Added/updated tests for changed behaviour
- [ ] Rebuilt and committed `dist/` (if `src/` changed)
- [ ] Updated `README.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` for user-facing changes
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or third-party sign-up requirement introduced
